  <defs>

    <!-- Horse chestnut gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="horse1Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">

    </linearGradient>

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0000FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00008B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silk3Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00FF00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#008B00"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <ellipse cx="1200" cy="140" rx="70" ry="35">

    <ellipse cx="1200" cy="200" rx="65" ry="30">
